info.title: bank
info.description: The bank command: archive and export your own bank transactions through Enable Banking.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Archive and export your own bank transactions through Enable Banking account information (read-only).

options.name: --data-dir
options.description: Use this directory for configuration, keys and bank.db instead of the platform defaults

options.name: --json
options.description: Write a single JSON document to stdout; progress and diagnostics go to stderr [default: False]

commands.name: connect
commands.description:
Authorise (or re-authorise) a bank connection with BankID or the bank's own method.
Examples:
  bank connect personal --bank SEB --country SE --psu-type personal
  bank connect business --bank SEB --country SE --psu-type business
  bank connect personal --manual

options.name: --bank
options.description: Bank (ASPSP) name, e.g. SEB. Defaults to the existing connection's bank

options.name: --country
options.description: ISO 3166 country code, e.g. SE. Defaults to the existing connection's country

options.name: --psu-type
options.description: personal or business. Defaults to the existing connection's type, else personal

options.name: --manual
options.description: Do not listen for the callback; paste the redirected URL from the browser (read from stdin) [default: False]

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: Print the authorisation URL instead of opening a browser [default: False]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Minutes to wait for the callback [default: 10]

arguments.name: CONNECTION
arguments.description: Local connection name, e.g. personal or business

commands.name: accounts
commands.description: List archived accounts and their selectors (offline).

commands.name: alias
commands.description:
Name an account so it can be selected as connection:alias.
Example: bank account alias business:3 operating

arguments.name: ACCOUNT
arguments.description: Account selector: connection:alias, connection:id, connection:IBAN or a local ID

arguments.name: ALIAS
arguments.description: New alias, unique within the connection

commands.name: balances
commands.description: Fetch current balances from the bank (online). Balances are provider-supplied, never calculated.

commands.name: sync
commands.description:
Fetch new and corrected booked transactions into the archive (online). Never starts bank authorisation.
Examples:
  bank sync personal
  bank sync --all --json

commands.name: transactions
commands.description:
Show archived booked transactions (offline). Date bounds are inclusive booking dates.
Example: bank transactions business:operating --from 2026-09-01 --to 2026-09-30

commands.name: export
commands.description:
Export archived booked transactions (offline) as UTF-8 CSV or JSON. Not an official bank statement.
CSV columns: account, booking_date, value_date, amount, currency, status, counterparty, description,
reference, entry_reference, transaction_id, local_id. Amounts are signed invariant decimals.
Examples:
  bank export business:operating --month 2026-09 --format csv
  bank export business:operating --month 2026-09 --format json -o september.json

options.name: --output
options.description: Write to this file instead of stdout

commands.name: status
commands.description: Consent expiry, sync history and archived coverage per connection (offline).

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check configuration, keys, callback, archive and (unless --offline) the API application. Changes nothing.

options.name: --offline
options.description: Skip checks that contact the API [default: False]
